long_biography.plain_text:
After completing primary school, Chiau Beng Teik went to work at 13 in the Alor Setar hardware shop established by his father, Chiau Kok Hia. He learned the trade, later assumed the business and added building-materials sales, cement transport and a distribution company. The operation grew from one office into branches and factories across Peninsular Malaysia.

At Chin Hin, Chiau focused on strategy, major investments and financing rather than daily operations. Manufacturing capacity, a Bursa Malaysia listing and acquisitions widened the group beyond distribution into construction engineering, property development and home-and-living businesses. A planned transition in 2026 moved him into the role of founder and chairman emeritus.
